data.title: 圣女贞德 · 奥尔良山岗的圣旗展开·「吾名贞德，此地由吾守护」
data.description: 【奥尔良郊外的山岗·战云低垂】狂风撕扯着战云，身着白银胸铠Ruler圣装的贞德立于山岗之巅。她双手高举神圣战旗吾主在此（Luminosité Éternelle），白披风在罡风中猎猎翻卷，旗面的圣辉劈开铅灰色的天空。金色的长辫与旗杆成一线绷直，紫蓝色的眼眸里没有半分动摇——圣女的祈祷，此刻化为一面绝不可能倒下的战旗。
data.location: 奥尔良郊外山岗最高点
data.action: 双手高举圣旗吾主在此，旗离地迎风展开，白披风与金辫齐扬
data.lighting: 圣旗迸发的白金圣辉与铅灰战云形成明暗对撞
data.camera: low angle full shot, banner raised skyward, wind and light burst, epic saint framing
data.promptProse: On the ridge above Orleans, Jeanne raises Luminosite Eternelle with both hands, its pole clear of the ground and cloth opening in the storm wind. Silver breastplate, white-and-blue armored vestments and flowing cape accompany her streaming golden braid. The low full-body view includes planted boots and the raised standard against grey battle clouds. White-gold holy radiance illuminates her resolute eyes and gauntlets, separating the banner from the darker sky.
